notes.title: Update Notes for December 4th, 2022
notes.content: My friend made background music for me so I added audio control to the game! Now you can turn the shooting down and the music up. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Update notes for August 19th, 2022
notes.content: Second update in like the last hour. Bbq's ability to phase through walls removed

notes.title: Update Notes for August 19th, 2022
notes.content: One of the reviews said they couldn't see the health and score so this update made them scale with screen size!

notes.title: Update Notes for August 9, 2022
notes.content: Added sprinting to the mayo jar, just hold shift

notes.title: Update nots for 7/16/2022
notes.content: Slight edit to how the sound plays, should sound better when shooting fast now

notes.title: Update Notes for July 13th
notes.content:
I ADDED SOUND 
AWESOME GUYS HOPE YOU LOVE IT

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/8/2022
notes.content: Another new enemy added, hope you guys like it. Slight edit to the relish model made to hopefully help make a bug that was pointed out less common.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/4/2022
notes.content:
Hello! New difficulty slider added in pause menu for people who think there's just not enough enemies ganging up on you. Also, my friend made me an asset for a new enemy that awaits you. 

Good luck mayo fans

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/25/2022
notes.content: Steam leaderboard integrated, can now keep track of high score in steam stats. Will find a way to import them to be visible in game in a future update.

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/24/2022
notes.content: New powerup added! Pick up the blue capsule and hold down the firing button! Also fixed another one of the get out of the map bugs...

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/23/2022
notes.content: Should not be able to jump out of the map anymore, fixed potential problem where health achievement was not earnable, made hostile bottles a little bit faster so they can keep up with that crazy mayo speed

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/22/2022
notes.content: Edited invisible walls to prevent a bug causing mayo to fall through the floor, new achievement for health

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/21/2022
notes.content: Added mustard, changed enemy drop spawn rate, added more background steam integration for future updates

notes.title: Update Notes for 5/19/2022
notes.content: Achievements should be functional now, have fun mayo fans

notes.title: Update notes for 5/17/2022
notes.content: Increased enemy spawn rate, decreased health item spawn rate, and moved invisible walls closer to the edge

notes.title: Update notes for 5/13/2022
notes.content: Pushed all changes made between announcement of the game and official release. Includes more ketchup, score, health, enemies drops, and another shelf.
